items.title: South Korean Stocks Jump 6% After Turbulent Week on AI Swings
items.description: South Korean stocks rebounded after a near 10% drop in the previous two sessions, highlighting skittish investor sentiment as scrutiny grows over the sustainability of the global AI boom.
items.title_original: South Korean Stocks Jump 6% After Turbulent Week on AI Swings
items.title_en: South Korean Stocks Jump 6% After Turbulent Week on AI Swings

items.title_clean: 韩国股市因AI波动震荡后反弹5%
items.summary: 韩国股市在连续两日下跌近10%后反弹5%，凸显投资者对全球AI热潮可持续性的担忧。这一市场波动反映了AI投资情绪的不稳定性，对产品经理评估AI商业化进程中的市场风险具有参考价值。
